prompt: Add time-travel loading to `AccountRepository`: `repo.load(account_id, as_of=n)` should return the account exactly as it was right after version n, starting from the newest snapshot whose version is <= n (full replay if there is none) and never applying events past n; an `as_of` outside 1..current version is a `ValueError`. Loading an account that has no events should raise a new `ledger.errors.AccountNotFound` (a `KeyError` subclass) instead of quietly returning a blank state. Also, we've seen balances drift when the same account is loaded more than once after a snapshot — a load must never modify or hand back a stored snapshot's state object.
